goal: Stop polluting debug logs with hourly connection failure warnings on nodes running without Tor
agreement: Objection: suppresses failure logs when -torcontrol is explicitly configured without -debug=tor (fjahr)
Verified by testing cleaner log output during Tor connection failures (pinheadmz, winterrdog)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a minor logging annoyance for default node setups without Tor
Prevents debug logs from filling with repetitive connection failure warnings every hour
Benefit is cosmetic log cleanup with no functional impact on network connectivity
